title: The real reason tech companies are firing engineers

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know tech giants are cutting engineering jobs right now?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just a layoff — it’s a strategic move to shift focus.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re replacing engineers with AI tools like GitHub Copilot and AutoML.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: These tools can write code, debug, and even optimize algorithms faster.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers who can’t adapt are being let go — over 100,000 jobs lost in 2024 alone.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future belongs to engineers who master AI, not just code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Can you keep up with the AI revolution in tech?
